title: Baa Juice Fresh Orange Fizz Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Fresh Orange Fizz Shortfill delivers a bright burst of citrus flavour. Juicy Orange takes the lead with its sweet, zesty character, lifted by a fizzy edge that gives the vape an effervescent twist. The result is a sharp yet playful fruit blend that stays lively with every puff. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Made with double-concentrated flavouring, Baa Juice Shortfills offer vivid, long-lasting taste, capturing fruit profiles with striking clarity.
